Title: Create Wishlist/List
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:USER_DEFAULT]
User logged in, no lists created
Steps:
1. [NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/account/lists
2. [ACT] click 'CREATE LIST' (`[data-test-id="create-wishlist-button"]`)
3. [ACT] fill the list-name field (`[data-test-id="wishlist-name-input"]`, placeholder 'Enter name') with 'Summer Essentials'
4. [ACT] click 'Save' (`[data-test-id="wishlist-settings-save-button"]`)
5. [ASSERT] verify list created
6. [ASSERT] verify list appears in My Lists
Assertions:
[DOM] 'CREATE LIST' button (`[data-test-id="create-wishlist-button"]`) visible on /account/lists
[DOM] create dialog shows the name field (`[data-test-id="wishlist-name-input"]`, placeholder 'Enter name') and a description field with a 0/250 character counter
[DOM] 'Save' button (`[data-test-id="wishlist-settings-save-button"]`) creates the list and returns to /account/lists
[DOM] created list appears as a list card (name link + item-count badge + 'Last modified' date) on /account/lists
[STATE] repeating the flow creates a second, independent list card
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] mutation errors[] is empty
[CONSOLE] no uncaught JS errors
Failure_Signals: Create button missing; form missing required fields; list not appearing in My Lists after creation; success message not shown
References: VCST-3928; Blocked: live selector pass on a customer account (USER_DEFAULT) found no Privacy/Shared control in the create dialog (Name + Description + 0/250 counter only) — not observed on a customer account, needs confirmation (possibly org-gated), not treated as refuted (2026-08-05)

[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:SALES_REP]

Match org_X by GUID, not by name — the customer picker contains genuinely distinct organizations with identical display names
Steps:
1. [ACT] as the rep, share a list with org_X and copy the Link; record the sharedWithId the ChangeWishlist mutation sent
2. [ACT] sign in as recipient and read the active organization id from GetMe / pageContext; confirm it equals the recorded sharedWithId when org_X is active
3. [ACT] switch the active organization to org_Y
4. [NAV] the shared-list URL
5. [ASSERT] record the outcome under org_Y
6. [ACT] switch the active organization back to org_X
7. [NAV] the same shared-list URL
8. [ASSERT] record the outcome under org_X
